SPF50+ PA++++. What it actually means.
SPF is for the rays that burn, PA for the rays that age. Four plus signs is the top UVA rating. And reapply every 2 to 3 hours.
🇫🇷 SPF = UVB, PA = UVA. ++++ = protection maximale. On réapplique.
